title: Quietly Fermented Moroccan Lentil Sellou
description: A flexitarian friendly Moroccan dish featuring molasses and lentils, perfect for a post workout meal, quietly fermented to bring out the flavors.
instructions: Rinse the lentils and soak them in water for at least 8 hours or overnight.
Drain and rinse the lentils, then transfer them to a pressure cooker with 2 cups of water.
Add the olive oil, onion, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper to the pressure cooker.
Close the lid and cook on high pressure for 20 minutes.
Let the pressure release naturally, then stir in the molasses.
Transfer the mixture to an earthenware bowl and let it ferment at room temperature for 24 hours.
After fermentation, stir the sellou well and serve.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
Store any leftovers in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
